SID_0000_0010g_00100_01050_1: I wonder if Carrie and Mister Monster will show up today.
SID_0000_0010g_00200_01050_1: Is this a story about me?
SID_0000_0010g_00250_01050_1: But I never saw Mister Monster there...
SID_0000_0010g_00300_01050_1: That monster looks different than the one I know.
SID_0000_0010g_00400_01050_1: What'll happen to Mister Monster and me?
SID_0000_0010g_00550_01050_1: I feel like something's...missing for some reason.
SID_0000_0020g_00100_01050_1: Am I alone today? No one's coming...
SID_0000_0020g_00300_01050_1: Mister Monster? Carrie? Is anyone here?
SID_0000_0020g_00400_01050_1: Am I always going to be alone here?
SID_0000_0030g_00100_01050_1: I feel like I'm forgetting something important.
SID_0000_0030g_00200_01050_1: I'm not sure, but...I feel like I had someone.
SID_0000_0030g_00300_01050_1: I can't remember who was so important to me.
SID_0000_0030g_00350_01050_1: Well, I guess I'm okay with dreams...
SID_0000_0030g_00500_01050_1: I'm going to work hard to be strong and kind so I can protect everyone.
SID_0000_0030g_00550_01050_1: And once I do, you should come back!
SID_0000_0030g_00560_01050_1: ...Gee, I sure hope that reached whoever it was that I forgot.
SID_0010_0010g_00150_02020_1: Hmm? How did I get here?
SID_0010_0010g_00200_02020_1: This is from... Wait, what's going on here?
SID_0010_0010g_00300_02020_1: I still remember her face... The smell of gunpowder...
SID_0010_0010g_00400_02020_1: Whoever was knocking at the door...
SID_0010_0010g_00450_02020_1: I probably should have been calmer about it.
SID_0010_0010g_00500_02020_1: Have I been given a chance to confront her once more?
SID_0010_0010g_00600_02020_1: Was that even real? Either way, there's no going back to that room...
SID_0010_0010g_00650_02020_1: Not that I can return to that time in my life anyway.
SID_0010_0020g_00100_02020_1: What a strange place... Why was it built?
SID_0010_0020g_00200_02020_1: My head hurts... It feels like I've stopped breathing.
SID_0010_0020g_00300_02020_1: How did they make this place...?
SID_0010_0020g_00400_02020_1: *cough* I wonder if he's here somewhere too.
SID_0010_0030g_00100_02020_1: Is there a reason I'm here?
SID_0010_0030g_00200_02020_1: In any case, I need to keep going.\nI don't have much time left.
SID_0010_0030g_00350_02020_1: No. This is a decision I need to make for myself.
SID_0010_0030g_00400_02020_1: This illness means I don't have much of a future...
SID_0010_0030g_00450_02020_1: But I'm going to carry on anyway.
SID_0010_0030g_00500_02020_1: If my dream of a peaceful world ever comes true, what wonderful things would the people create?
SID_0010_0030g_00550_02020_1: Ah, if only I could be there to see what sort of life he'll have...
SID_0020_0010g_00100_02040_1: I require time to assess the situation.
SID_0020_0010g_00400_02040_1: The actions of my prince changed the world...
SID_0020_0010g_00600_02040_1: The light within me will never again be extinguished.
SID_0020_0020g_00100_02040_1: I must search for truth in this place.
SID_0020_0020g_00300_02040_1: Perhaps he is here as well...
SID_0020_0020g_00400_02040_1: Why am I not by his side?
SID_0020_0030g_00100_02040_1: He told me to find the reason I live...
SID_0020_0030g_00200_02040_1: I have meaning when I am with you.
SID_0020_0030g_00400_02040_1: I know my path, even if my calculations do not provide an answer.
SID_0020_0030g_00500_02040_1: Did I ever bring his wishes to life? ...No matter.
SID_0020_0030g_00550_02040_1: My end will be chosen through my will alone.
SID_0030_0010g_00100_02030_1: There are so many doors... I wonder where they lead?
SID_0030_0010g_00200_02030_1: Now that I think about it, this place feels a lot like that facility.
SID_0030_0010g_00300_02030_1: I had no idea such awful things were happening there...
SID_0030_0010g_00400_02030_1: Her voice. Her scent. Her warmth. I'll never forget those things...
SID_0030_0010g_00500_02030_1: But now? I'll have to go it alone.
SID_0030_0010g_00600_02030_1: I'm a weapon, and I must stay away from her and my home... \nAt least until I find a way to quell this rage.
SID_0030_0020g_00100_02030_1: I was chasing kingdom soldiers when I found myself here...
SID_0030_0020g_00200_02030_1: For some reason, my prosthetics are in better shape than usual. They're moving so...smoothly.
SID_0030_0020g_00300_02030_1: This place reminds me of that time...
SID_0030_0020g_00400_02030_1: Is this a subconscious reality? If so, maybe my body will...
SID_0030_0030g_00100_02030_1: How long have I been here...? I've lost all sense of time.
SID_0030_0030g_00200_02030_1: I have to destroy the kingdom...but why?
SID_0030_0030g_00300_02030_1: ...That's right. I made a vow to sacrifice all that I am.
SID_0030_0030g_00400_02030_1: My life has been stained by vengeance, so I'm going to see this through to the bitter end.
SID_0030_0030g_00500_02030_1: Thanks for listening, but...I don't want you watching over me anymore.
SID_0030_0030g_00550_02030_1: I'll see you again when this is all over. I promise.
SID_0040_0010g_00100_01040_1: ...Hm? Where did Carrier and the girl go?
SID_0040_0010g_00300_01040_1: There's something familiar about those kids...
SID_0040_0010g_00600_01040_1: If someone stands in your way, just get rid of them.
SID_0040_0010g_00800_01040_1: That boy is... Could I be...?
SID_0040_0020g_00100_01040_1: Carrier, you filthy liar... You said you'd feed me dreams.
SID_0040_0020g_00300_01040_1: If Carrier doesn't show up in the next five seconds, I'm going to kill him. Five...four...
SID_0040_0030g_00100_01040_1: That boy wished to become a monster.
SID_0040_0030g_00200_01040_1: He wanted the power to save his friend...
SID_0040_0030g_00400_01040_1: And yet, I can't help but identify with that boy...
SID_0040_0030g_00500_01040_1: Perhaps there's something I'm unable to remember...
SID_0040_0030g_00600_01040_1: But that doesn't matter as long as I get to eat her dreams. Yes, that's all I need...
SID_0040_0030g_00700_01040_1: If monsters truly do possess the power to save their friends...
SID_0050_0010g_00100_02090_1: ...Where am I? How did I get here?
SID_0050_0010g_00200_02090_1: Am I being shown my own memories?
SID_0050_0010g_00300_02090_1: Already feeling pretty over this whole thing.
SID_0050_0010g_00400_02090_1: I'm used to getting betrayed. No point in letting myself get bothered by it now.
SID_0050_0010g_00600_02090_1: There are some times you've no choice but to press on.
SID_0050_0010g_00700_02090_1: If anything does come after revenge... I hope I can find it.
SID_0050_0020g_00200_02090_1: Would someone let me the hell out of here already? I'm getting real sick of this.
SID_0050_0020g_00300_02090_1: How long do I have to keep fighting?
SID_0050_0020g_00400_02090_1: Hm? I feel like I just heard his voice...
SID_0050_0030g_00200_02090_1: All I could do was repeat that cycle.
SID_0050_0030g_00300_02090_1: I can't stop, no matter how scared I might be.
SID_0050_0030g_00400_02090_1: What lies beyond all this fighting?
SID_0050_0030g_00500_02090_1: Will there ever be an end to all of this?
SID_0050_0030g_00600_02090_1: What I've lost cannot be reclaimed.
SID_0060_0010g_00200_02110_1: Those big white wings... It's almost like...
SID_0060_0010g_00300_02110_1: I needed to go to that place. It was all I could think about.
SID_0060_0010g_00500_02110_1: I will protect the place my sister cherished.
SID_0060_0010g_00600_02110_1: That day... I laughed... I cried...
SID_0060_0020g_00100_02110_1: ...So how am I supposed to get out of here?
SID_0060_0020g_00300_02110_1: Do I have to fight again?
SID_0060_0020g_00400_02110_1: I...will protect my sister's memories in this place. Forever.
SID_0060_0030g_00200_02110_1: That day... In that facility... Why did I wake up?
SID_0060_0030g_00300_02110_1: The memories of weapons like myself get passed on without end.
SID_0060_0030g_00400_02110_1: I'll never forget seeing everyone crystallized in the facility.
SID_0060_0030g_00500_02110_1: Even if I die, it's still not the end...
SID_0060_0030g_00600_02110_1: I will go on protecting my sister's memories.
SID_0060_0030g_00700_02110_1: ...Yeah. For all of eternity. Even if everything disappears someday.
SID_0070_0010g_00200_02070_1: Freedom... A concept so bright it almost burns.
SID_0070_0010g_00300_02070_1: Our hearts have been torn asunder time and again, in different ways...
SID_0070_0010g_00400_02070_1: Even if what binds us is a curse, I am thankful for that fate all the same.
SID_0070_0010g_00500_02070_1: If there is one thing that can never be taken from us, it is the heart.
SID_0070_0010g_00600_02070_1: In this cruel world, you are my everything.
SID_0070_0020g_00100_02070_1: What a mysterious place... It's both beautiful, yet dreary.
SID_0070_0020g_00200_02070_1: How am I supposed to get out?
SID_0070_0020g_00300_02070_1: I wonder if my wife is lost somewhere as well.
SID_0070_0030g_00100_02070_1: My whole life, I've walked the path that was laid out for me.
SID_0070_0030g_00200_02070_1: I never had any idea I was kept alive at the whims of another.
SID_0070_0030g_00300_02070_1: I do not require any great happiness. All I need...is her.
SID_0070_0030g_00400_02070_1: We will live for ourselves... That is my choice. Our choice.
SID_0070_0030g_00500_02070_1: Even if we find suffering on our path, we will never stop walking.
SID_0070_0030g_00600_02070_1: For even in a world marching toward its end, there is joy to be found.
SID_0070_0030g_00700_02070_1: Our existence is proof of that.
SID_0080_0010g_00200_02050_1: Our pasts will chase us for as long as we live... I am no exception to that rule.
SID_0080_0010g_00300_02050_1: How could you remain so true to yourself until the very end?
SID_0080_0010g_00400_02050_1: I always found it much easier to play the role of demon.
SID_0080_0010g_00500_02050_1: If she's not with me, there's no place in this world that isn't like hell to me...
SID_0080_0010g_00600_02050_1: My resentment knows no bounds. I could claim a hundred lives and still not be satisfied.
SID_0080_0020g_00100_02050_1: I must admit I do not dislike quit places like this.
SID_0080_0020g_00200_02050_1: Would there be any meaning in my leaving this place?
SID_0080_0020g_00400_02050_1: I wish I would just be allowed to sleep already...
SID_0080_0030g_00100_02050_1: An ordinary, honest life was too good a thing for me to begin with...
SID_0080_0030g_00200_02050_1: She always smiled enough for the both of us.
SID_0080_0030g_00300_02050_1: Power alone is meaningless no matter how much of it you possess,\nas there's a limit to what its use can gain you.
SID_0080_0030g_00400_02050_1: I must face this truth... For her sake as well as my own.
SID_0080_0030g_00500_02050_1: ...I think I may finally understand what it is she wished of me.
SID_0080_0030g_00600_02050_1: It's a realization it took me entirely too long to make... I was shameful until the very end.
SID_0090_0010g_00600_02100_1: ...I didn't want to remember any of this.
SID_0090_0020g_00100_02100_1: ...I suppose I should look for a way out of here.
SID_0090_0020g_00200_02100_1: Hm... I wonder if that kid's around here somewhere too.
SID_0090_0020g_00300_02100_1: I hope my next battle works out too...
SID_0090_0020g_00400_02100_1: Guess I'll take a little break...
SID_0090_0030g_00100_02100_1: ...I had been thinking back on that time.
SID_0090_0030g_00200_02100_1: Was that really the only way my life could have ended?
SID_0090_0030g_00300_02100_1: Maybe things would have turned out differently if I had never met him... And yet...
SID_0090_0030g_00400_02100_1: I think it's fine like this. I have no regrets.
SID_0090_0030g_00500_02100_1: I was always looking for someone who was like me...
SID_0100_0010g_00300_02080_1: The truth is always cruel...\nBut it must be faced if one is to move on. I know that much.
SID_0100_0010g_00400_02080_1: The realization of what I was destined to do just...came to me one day.\nSurely everyone has moments like that.
SID_0100_0010g_00500_02080_1: Once I've decided to press on, there is no turning back...\nEven if the path before me leads directly to Hell.
SID_0100_0010g_00600_02080_1: I don't mind dying if it means I lived on my own terms.
SID_0100_0020g_00100_02080_1: I wonder if he's here too...
SID_0100_0020g_00200_02080_1: I feel like I can sense him here... Oh, how I wish to see him so.
SID_0100_0020g_00300_02080_1: Even if my entire existence was built on falsehoods, I long for him all the same.
SID_0100_0020g_00400_02080_1: I don't need my life to have some kind of inherent meaning.\nI'll search for meaning in it myself.
SID_0100_0030g_00100_02080_1: All I had in my heart was revenge... It consumed my every waking moment.
SID_0100_0030g_00200_02080_1: We were just pawns... Pawns intended to maintain the existing world order.
SID_0100_0030g_00300_02080_1: I never intended to become a martyr for some greater cause...\nI just wanted to cut us loose from everything that bound us.
SID_0100_0030g_00400_02080_1: Some endings give rise to new beginnings. Surely that's true of all things.
SID_0100_0030g_00500_02080_1: My life was a happy. I have no regrets.
SID_0100_0030g_00600_02080_1: The sky I saw with him in my last moments... It was just so breathtaking...
SID_0110_0010g_00100_02060_1: Never been here before. This is great!
SID_0110_0010g_00300_02060_1: I can't stand being stuck just watching!
SID_0110_0010g_00600_02060_1: Anyway, staying put here will do me no good.
SID_0110_0020g_00100_02060_1: How can I get myself outta here?
SID_0110_0020g_00200_02060_1: Maybe force is the only way...
SID_0110_0030g_00100_02060_1: My wife gave a worthless lug like me a reason to live.
SID_0110_0030g_00200_02060_1: My daughter put my stupid statement behind her and became a fine adventurer.
SID_0110_0030g_00300_02060_1: And it seems like my son grew up hale and hearty despite my worries.
SID_0110_0030g_00400_02060_1: ...A family that great was wasted on me.
SID_0110_0030g_00500_02060_1: Looks like I can finally get outta here... I wonder where I should head next.
